meta_description: Sunny Gardening & Landscape in Liverpool offers professional garden design, maintenance, and landscaping. Free quotes available. Call 07400 904632.
hero_subhead: From overgrown gardens to stunning outdoor living spaces, we design and maintain gardens that Liverpool homeowners love.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Landscaping Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, regular maintenance, or specialist landscaping work, we handle every aspect of your outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create outdoor rooms that work for families, entertaining, and year-round enjoyment.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Regular cutting, pruning, weeding, and lawn care to keep your garden looking sharp. Flexible weekly or fortnightly visits to suit your needs.

services.title: Landscaping & Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Patios, decking, raised beds, pathways, and boundary work. We build sturdy, beautiful features that last and transform how you use your garden.

services.title: Lawn Establishment & Renovation
services.desc: New lawns from seed or turf, plus restoration of tired or patchy grass. We prepare the ground properly for a healthy, dense lawn.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Work
services.desc: Pruning, trimming, felling, and stump removal carried out safely. We also shape hedges and maintain specimen trees to enhance your garden structure.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Borders
services.desc: Colourful perennial and annual planting schemes designed to give year-round interest. We source quality plants and establish them properly.

about_pullquote: A great garden shouldn't be a luxury — it should be an escape you actually enjoy.
about_para_1: Sunny Gardening & Landscape was founded on a simple idea: every home deserves an outdoor space that brings joy and adds genuine value. Over 15 years, we've transformed more than 500 gardens across Liverpool — from small urban backyards to large period properties. Our team combines horticultural knowledge with practical building skills, so whether you need a complete redesign or ongoing care, we deliver results that last.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen. We don't impose one-size-fits-all solutions; instead, we design gardens around how you actually live. We're honest about timescales and budgets, turn up when we say we will, and take pride in the detail. Many of our best projects come from word-of-mouth referrals — a true sign that people trust us with their gardens.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our back garden was a complete mess — overgrown, uneven, no structure whatsoever. Dave came round, listened to what we wanted, and designed something beautiful. The team worked hard and left everything tidy. It's transformed how we use our garden. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Been using Sunny Gardening for three years now. Regular maintenance, always professional, never let us down. They pruned a big oak tree beautifully last spring and the new patio they laid is brilliant. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Margaret C.

reviews.text: Called for a free quote on reshaping our front and back gardens. They got back to us within two days with detailed plans and fair pricing. Work started on time and finished ahead of schedule. Really happy with the result.
reviews.author: Paul K.
